record.paper_title: Two open problems in graph theory
record.original_question: Does there exist an infinite hypohamiltonian graph in which every vertex has finite degree; that is, a locally finite infinite hypohamiltonian graph?

evidence.quote: Infinite hypohamiltonian graphs have been considered by Thomassen [30] but none of his examples are locally finite. That is, none of them have every vertex of finite degree. Do locally finite infinite hypohamiltonian graphs exist?

artifact.self_contained_problem: A simple graph $G = (V,E)$ (possibly infinite) is called hypohamiltonian if $G$ itself contains no Hamiltonian cycle (a cycle, possibly two-way infinite, passing through every vertex exactly once; for an infinite graph this is interpreted as a spanning two-way infinite path/cycle), while for every vertex $v \in V$ the subgraph $G - v$ obtained by deleting $v$ does contain such a Hamiltonian cycle. The graph $G$ is called locally finite if every vertex has finite degree.\n\nDecide whether there exists a locally finite infinite hypohamiltonian graph, i.e., an infinite simple graph $G$ in which every vertex has finite degree, $G$ has no Hamiltonian cycle, but $G - v$ has a Hamiltonian cycle for every vertex $v$ of $G$.
artifact.status_search_result: Web searches turned up no reference constructing or ruling out a locally finite infinite hypohamiltonian graph. Thomassen's known infinite hypohamiltonian examples are not locally finite, and no later work was found that resolves the locally finite case, so the status appears unverified.

status_evidence.title: Hypohamiltonian graph - Wikipedia
status_evidence.snippet: Discussion of hypohamiltonian graphs and known constructions, with no mention of a locally finite infinite example.
status_evidence.claim: No locally finite infinite hypohamiltonian graph is listed among known results.

status_evidence.title: Hypohamiltonian graphs and digraphs (Thomassen)
status_evidence.snippet: Thomassen's work on planar and infinite hypohamiltonian and hypotraceable graphs.
status_evidence.claim: Thomassen produced infinite hypohamiltonian graphs but they are not locally finite.
